reason: I would download it and maybe take the free 14 days since no card is needed, but 24,990 every month for a phone app feels like a lot when I am already planning to pay a real English tutor for school prep. The free letters and numbers in one language is probably enough for my child at 4-5.
objection: I do not want to pay monthly for something on the phone; a real teacher or a workbook feels more serious for getting into a private school, and I am not sure 10 minutes in an app teaches anything that sticks.
would_change_my_mind: If after the free trial the weekly report showed my child really learned new English letters and other mums in the kindergarten Telegram group said their children got ready for school with it.
